此工作流程适用于 Anima Turbo 10 步文本到图像。它被设计为一种快速草稿生成路径，用于测试提示、探索图像方向、构建封面概念以及生成快速动画风格的视觉预览，而无需在每个渲染上花费太多时间。

该工作流程使用anima_turboV10.safetensors作为主模型，qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors作为文本编码器，qwen_image_vae.safetensors作为VAE。结构故意简单：正提示、负提示、潜在图像、KSampler、VAE 解码和保存图像。这使得它易于理解，易于修改，适合快速在线使用。

默认采样设置为 10 步、CFG 1.0、欧拉采样器、简单调度程序和完全降噪。这很重要：这个 Turbo 工作流程不应被视为高 CFG 美学模型。它专为低 CFG、低步长、快速响应生成而设计。将 CFG 提高得太高很容易使结果变得更糟、更僵化或不太稳定。

工作流程仅是纯文本到图像。它不需要图像输入、控制图像、姿势图像、掩模或参考图像。你只需要写一个提示，设置大小，然后生成。它特别适合快速动漫插图草稿、角色方向测试、缩略图概念、安全海报构图和社交媒体视觉预览。

主要特点：

  • Anima Turbo 10 步文本到图像工作流程

  • 快速草稿生成

  • anima_turboV10.safetensors 模型路线

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors 文本编码器

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • 10步快速采样

  • CFG 1.0 设置

  • 欧拉采样器

  • 简单的调度程序

  • 1024×1024默认潜在尺寸

  • 正负提示控制

  • 纯文本到图像的工作流程

  • 适用于即时测试、草稿生成、封面概念和动漫风格预览

建议的工作流程：

当您首先需要速度时，请使用此工作流程。从清晰的主题、干净的构图、可读的轮廓和简单的照明方向开始。避免在早期测试期间提示过于拥挤。快速生成多个草稿，选择最强的方向，然后在需要更完整的图像时转向美学 1.0 或美学 1.0b。 CFG保持在1.0左右，主要通过提示来控制结果。

o.en:
This workflow is for Anima Turbo 10-Step Text-to-Image. It is designed as a fast draft-generation route for testing prompts, exploring image directions, building cover concepts, and producing quick anime-style visual previews without spending too much time on every single render.

The workflow uses anima_turboV10.safetensors as the main model, qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors as the text encoder, and qwen_image_vae.safetensors as the VAE. The structure is intentionally simple: positive prompt, negative prompt, latent image, KSampler, VAE Decode, and Save Image. This makes it easy to understand, easy to modify, and suitable for fast online use.

The default sampling setup is 10 steps, CFG 1.0, euler sampler, simple scheduler, and full denoise. This is important: this Turbo workflow should not be treated like a high-CFG aesthetic model. It is built for low-CFG, low-step, fast-response generation. Raising CFG too high can easily make the result worse, more rigid, or less stable.

The workflow is pure text-to-image only. It does not require image input, control image, pose image, mask, or reference image. You only need to write a prompt, set the size, and generate. It is especially suitable for fast anime illustration drafts, character direction tests, thumbnail concepts, safe poster compositions, and social-media visual previews.

Main features:

  • Anima Turbo 10-Step text-to-image workflow

  • Fast draft generation

  • anima_turboV10.safetensors model route

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors text encoder

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • 10-step fast sampling

  • CFG 1.0 setup

  • euler sampler

  • simple scheduler

  • 1024×1024 default latent size

  • Positive and negative prompt control

  • Pure text-to-image workflow

  • Suitable for prompt testing, draft generation, cover concepts, and anime-style previews

Suggested workflow:

Use this workflow when you need speed first. Start with a clear subject, clean composition, readable silhouette, and simple lighting direction. Avoid making the prompt too crowded during early testing. Generate multiple drafts quickly, pick the strongest direction, then move to Aesthetic 1.0 or Aesthetic 1.0b when you need a more finished image. Keep CFG around 1.0 and control the result mainly through the prompt.
